subject: general
question: In a certain code language, if 'PDU' is written as '40' and 'HXO' is written as '34', how will 'BMW' be written in the same code language?
solution: The logic followed here is: Sum of the positional value of opposite letter of the give letters. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ba9641975f2fc7524ff111ee5de92ae0deecda54903f9932e1bcb1ebbbc99a46.png] •
